vulkathunha-gammon-ranges-4.name: Weetootla Gorge
vulkathunha-gammon-ranges-4.bio: Walk Weetootla Gorge from the campground trailhead, 7 km from Balcanoona in Vulkathunha-Gammon Ranges.

notes.pin: Trailhead is 7.1 km from Balcanoona (turn off Arkaroola Road 1.9 km from Balcanoona signpost); pin the hike at midpoint of the Weetootla Gorge route, not the campground.
notes.other: Park page: free entry. Park alert: closed 9pm 31 Oct to 9pm 12 Nov 2026 for pest control. Camping needs booking and fees (not a cost of the walk).

giant-gum-tree.name: Giant Gum Tree
giant-gum-tree.bio: River red gum over 500 years old in an Orroroo park with picnic tables and an electric barbecue.
giant-gum-tree.ticket_note: No single steward found; tourism listing only (council park).

notes.pin: In a park in Orroroo town; use the tree itself (OSM natural=tree or Wikivoyage/tourism geotag).
notes.other: Listing: trunk circumference over 10 m; signage tells its story.

magnetic-hill.name: Magnetic Hill
magnetic-hill.bio: Roadside illusion on Pekina-Blackrock Road where cars seem to roll uphill, on a 44 km loop from Orroroo.
magnetic-hill.ticket_note: Roadside site with no steward site.

notes.pin: Pekina-Blackrock Road, about 3 km past Pekina and 7 km from Black Rock; the large magnet symbol marks the spot.

carrieton.name: Carrieton
carrieton.bio: Small town with a 12 m tile mosaic mural of its history and a painted landscape mural at the pool.

yunta.name: Yunta
yunta.bio: Barrier Highway town between Peterborough and Broken Hill, home of the Yunta Picnic Races.

notes.pin: Draft is Wikipedia point for the town.

heysen-trail.name: Heysen Trail
heysen-trail.bio: Long-distance walking trail of about 1,200 km from Cape Jervis to Parachilna Gorge.

notes.pin: Long trail: pin in the Flinders end (Parachilna Gorge / Wilpena section) midpoint of the Flinders sections visitors use, or whole-route centre per rule; this spot sits in the Flinders region.
notes.other: Friends of the Heysen Trail site loaded (title checked). Fire-danger season closes the trail north of Tanunda. Hours 24-720 from draft.
notes.unverified_note: Ticket link is the volunteer Friends group, which maintains the trail with the SA Government.

mawson-trail.name: Mawson Trail
mawson-trail.bio: Mountain-bike trail of about 900 km from the Adelaide Hills north to Blinman in the Flinders Ranges.
mawson-trail.ticket_note: Official government page orsr.sa.gov.au/get-active/recreation-and-trails/mawson-trail is bot-blocked; needs browser check.

notes.pin: Long trail; pin in Flinders end near Blinman or whole-route centre per rule.
notes.other: Official page found via search (Office for Recreation, Sport and Racing); not loaded.

southern-flinders-rail-trail.name: Southern Flinders Rail Trail
southern-flinders-rail-trail.bio: Cycling trail on a disused railway line through Southern Flinders Ranges farmland and towns.

caernarvon-track.name: Caernarvon Track
caernarvon-track.bio: Self-drive 4WD climb to the 921 m summit of Mount Caernarvon with 360 degree views of the ranges.

notes.pin: Midpoint of the track between the reserve entry and Mount Caernarvon summit (The Bunkers Conservation Reserve, northeast of Ikara-Flinders Ranges NP).
notes.other: Search result summary: $60 per vehicle (an older listing said $70); bookings essential, cash only; camping $20 per vehicle; open 1 Apr-30 Oct per one listing, ExplorOz says all year. Official site loaded but fee not read from it. Experienced 4WD only.
